description.value: Skyride is a full-service mountain bike shop on Silver Star Road in Vernon, BC, carrying premium brands like Devinci and Rocky Mountain alongside a comprehensive repair operation staffed by trained mechanics. The shop runs a tiered service menu from basic safety inspections through full tear-down pro tunes, and also offers a Skyride Academy for riders looking to deepen their mechanical knowledge. Visiting cyclists will find a knowledgeable crew, a solid parts and accessories inventory, and a rental fleet that includes e-MTBs and downhill bikes for exploring the region's terrain.

address.value: 4815 Silver Star Road Vernon, BC V1B 3K3

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at skyride.ca provides clear evidence of a full-service bike shop with expert technicians offering repair packages across 'every make and model,' confirming staff can assist with urgent mechanicals. Bike rentals (Light Enduro, E-bike MTB, DH) are explicitly listed on the rentals subpage. No mention of a public floor pump, washrooms, DIY stand, touring-specific parts, or other amenities was found anywhere in the fetched content.
